statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of transient neurological deficits consistent with a transient cerebral ischemic attack
The patient has established atherosclerotic heart disease
The patient has nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency
A 48-hour ambulatory electrocardiographic monitoring study, CPT 93226, is ordered
The service is being evaluated for paroxysmal arrhythmias that may be contributing to embolic events
The claim was denied based on Reason Code CO-22
The denial is based on coordination of benefits regulations indicating care may be covered by another payer
The insurer is the secondary payer
